items.title: MECH-449/ARC-107: where does the perseveration No-Go actually go INERT? Keyed to REALIZED envelope size after finding the floor->envelope map is non-monotone (V3-EXQ-937 successor)
items.note: SUCCESSOR TO V3-EXQ-937 (does NOT supersede it -- 937's curve is a valid measurement and its evidence stays active). WHAT 937 FOUND: sweeping f_eligibility_envelope_floor 0.30->0.05 (3 seeds x 128 banks, all 3 readiness preconditions MET) gave ARM_CONSTITUTION conversion 0.685/0.823/0.898/0.956/0.979/0.997 with ARM_OFF and ARM_SHUFFLED at 0.000 at EVERY dose -- total specificity, so conversion is attributable to the CONTENT of MECH-260's recency vector at all six doses (926a had that control at one dose). It also REFUTED V3-EXQ-926a's stock-floor anchor: 926a reported conversion 1/16 with median envelope 1 at floor 0.30; 937 measured 0.685 with envelope 2.0. The perseveration leg is NOT inert at the shipped default. 937 FAILed only because its C1 bar (0.40) was arithmetic on that non-replicating anchor, and it emitted the label 'conversion_independent_of_envelope_width' while its own C2 monotonicity criterion had PASSED -- an absence claim contradicted by a sibling criterion in the same manifest. THE LOAD-BEARING DISCOVERY OF THIS SUCCESSOR (measured during authoring, 128 banks, seed 42): THE FLOOR -> ENVELOPE MAP IS NON-MONOTONE. floor 0.60 -> realized envelope 4.0, conversion 0.781; floor 0.40 -> envelope 1.0, conversion 0.227; floor 0.30 -> envelope 2.0, conversion 0.648. Raising the floor does NOT monotonically shrink the eligible set -- once no candidate clears the bar the fail-open guard admits the FULL set again, so realized envelope runs 4 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 as the floor falls and the inert point sits near 0.40, not at the top of the ladder. 937's clean monotone curve was an artifact of sampling only 0.30->0.05, a window over which the map happens to be monotone. THRESHOLD NOT RE-FIT: the C1 bar stays at 0.40; what changed is the COMPARISON it is applied to. Every criterion is now keyed to REALIZED ENVELOPE SIZE (the actual mediator) rather than to floor endpoints -- C1 contrasts cells at realized envelope >=3 against cells at realized envelope <=1 (the gng_protect_min_eligible regime, where the guard refuses to drop the last survivor so conversion is suppressed BY CONSTRUCTION). Lowering the bar to make 937 pass was explicitly rejected per /queue-experiment ('NEVER lower the threshold to resolve it'). The 11-point floor ladder (0.60..0.05) exists purely to SAMPLE envelope sizes well; floor-keyed readouts are still recorded because the fold-back is itself a finding. SELF-CAUGHT DESIGN ERROR, recorded because it validates the gate: this script's FIRST draft keyed C1 to floor endpoints (0.60 vs 0.10) assuming 0.60 would be inert. Its own P2 readiness precondition caught it -- env_dose_separation 0.5 against a 1.0 floor -- and self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue instead of emitting a bogus curve. The gate worked; the design was wrong and was fixed before queuing. ROUTING-LABEL DEFECT FIXED: the C1-fails branch is split, so C1-short-but-C2-monotone now routes to 'graded_dose_response_below_prereg_lift' and the absence claim is made only when C2 also fails. C4 (reported, NOT gated): was an inert regime reached at all? Failing to reach inertness even at realized envelope 1 would mean envelope width does not gate this leg -- the informative null -- and must not be collapsed into a mere FAIL. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-449 = 0, ARC-107 = 0, NOT braked. MECH-439 = 12 with ceiling_decision exhausted and is DELIBERATELY NOT TAGGED (no F-dominance lever here). MECH-260 not tagged (falsifier is behavioural, vacuous at the MECH-457 competence floor). HONEST LIMIT: ARM_OFF converts exactly 0.000 at every dose BY CONSTRUCTION -- its arm selector IS the baseline config, so its pick cannot differ from the baseline pick that defines the incumbent. It is tautological on this metric and proves nothing about the envelope; retained only because it costs nothing and its per-cell envelope diagnostic is informative. PURPOSE=diagnostic: excluded from confidence/conflict scoring; PROMOTES NOTHING. SMOKE PASS on the Mac (floors 0.40 and 0.10, chosen to span BOTH realized-envelope regimes rather than the floor endpoints): outcome=PASS, per-seed lift 0.75/1.0 vs the unchanged 0.40 bar, env_sep 2.0, empty_eligible=0. validate_experiments.py --strict OK, 0 warnings of every class.
